comment: Path map for the skill and command transforms. Ordered rewrite rules for Claude paths in markdown: first match per scan position wins (earlier rules consume text before later ones see it). 'match' = literal, 'regex' = JS regex source (global). builtSkillsOnly: the $1 skill name must be in the build. examples: one fixture per rule, asserted by tests/cursor-plugin/skills.test.js. skillOverrides: per-skill literal rewrites applied BEFORE the global rules. claudeAllowlist: skills whose remaining .claude/ lines are intentional (Claude-side subject or shipped-script-verbatim paths); matching lines skip path/tool rules, and the test fails on any .claude/ line outside this list.

# Code Review

Delegated review uses the `ecc-code-reviewer` and `ecc-security-reviewer` subagents, each in its own environment when both run. The checklist below is what they apply.
